desc: Built Rugged For Military, Police, And Law Abiding Citizens, The Mossberg 500 Tactical Line Offers Mission-Ready Shotguns For Any Scenario. FEATURES: Dual extractors, positive steel-to-steel lockup, twin action bars, and an anti-jam elevator ensure smooth operation. Top mounted safety provides for ambidextrous operation. Additional special features offered enhance suitability for low and no-light conditions including Center Mass Laser equipped models, tri-railed forends to facilitate accessory lights and lasers, adjustable stocks for rapid adjustment of length of pull coupled with a broad range of accessory barrels make the 500/590 one of the most adaptable firearms in history.
